description: 法国古典变 C11 — 空间优势的正确跟进：三件套作战计划

intro.popup_en: Space Cramping, Lesson 4: What comes after gaining space? Space alone is not enough; a coordinated piece plan is needed to turn it into an attack. Follow White's three-part plan: Be3, Qd2, and queenside castling.
intro.popup:
空间挤压 第4课

建立了空间优势，然后呢？

光有空间不够！
必须有配套的子力计划
才能把优势变成进攻！

跟踪白方的三件套计划：
Be3 → Qd2 → O-O-O

outro.popup_en: White's plan is to establish the e5 wedge and support it with f4, defend the center with Be3 and Nxd4, then coordinate with Qd2 and O-O-O. Space plus a target and a concrete plan converts the advantage.
outro.popup:
正确使用空间优势

三件套模板：
① 楔子e5 + 支援f4
② Be3守护 + Nxd4控线
③ Qd2指向 + O-O-O连接

空间 + 目标 + 执行 = 优势！

moves.popup: d5 反中心！双方争夺中心

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances the wedge and forces Nf6 to retreat.
moves.popup:
e5！推进楔子！
Nf6必须撤退……

moves.popup_en: ...Nfd7 retreats because f6 is blocked by White's pawn on e5.
moves.popup:
Nfd7 马被迫撤退
f6格被占，只能去d7

moves.popup_en: f4! This is the correct follow-up: it supports the e5 wedge and prepares f5 against Black's kingside. The advance is part of a plan, not an isolated pawn move.
moves.popup:
f4！⭐正确的跟进！

f4支援e5楔子！
这不是随意推进，而是计划的一部分：
f4→f5，进攻黑方王翼！

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black attacks d4, the base of White's center. This is Black's key counterplay.
moves.popup:
c5 黑方反击d4！
这是黑方的核心对抗手段

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and adds pressure to d4.
Be3! The first part of White's plan: develop the bishop, defend d4, and prepare Qd2. Each move contributes to the same coordinated strategy.
moves.popup:
Be3！⭐三件套第一件！

Be3守护d4，发展象
同时为Qd2做准备

白方每一步都有协调意图！

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges and attacks the pawn on d4.
Nxd4! The knight recaptures on d4 and maintains White's central control.
moves.popup:
Nxd4！马重新占领d4
中心控制维持！

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 attacks the knight on d4 and adds counterpressure.
moves.popup:
Bc5 象出来攻击d4！
黑方的反压力来了

moves.popup_en: Qd2! The second part of the plan: prepare queenside castling, point toward h6 with a possible Bh6, and connect the rooks. White's strategy is now coordinated.
moves.popup:
Qd2！⭐三件套第二件！

后来到d2：
① 准备长易位
② 指向h6（Bh6是威胁）
③ 连接两车

白方整体战略已成形！

moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles kingside, moving the king toward the side White is targeting.
moves.popup:
O-O 黑方入城！
王移向翼侧……但白方正盯着这里！

moves.popup_en: O-O-O! The third part completes the plan. White's rook reaches d1, while the queen, rook, knight, and bishop coordinate around the center. White can attack with g4-h4-f5 or Nf5. Space, a clear target, and coordinated execution turn the advantage into an attack.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！⭐三件套第三件！

长易位！计划完成！

白方现在：
① 车在d1，对齐d-线
② 后+车+Nxd4+Be3全部协调
③ 进攻方向：g4-h4-f5或Nf5

这就是空间优势的正确使用：
有楔子 + 有计划 + 子力全部执行！
